easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Unctus.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
The Notary Hobbits trigger, causing you to loot.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.
